newsitem.title: USA: Royal Caribbean says tightens disposal rules.
newsitem.headline: Royal Caribbean says tightens disposal rules.

text.p: Royal Caribbean Cruises Ltd, indicted Thursday for allegedly conspiring to dump waste oil in U.S. waters, said it has taken steps to increase monitoring and enforcement of rules for disposing of oily bilge water since it learned of the allegation two years ago.
"Royal Caribbean is concerned about the environment and deplores the reported violations of its policies as well as international environmental laws," the Miami-based company said in a statement.
Two employees named in the indictment have been placed on administrative leave, the company said.

A federal grand jury in San Juan, Puerto Rico, indicted the cruise line for alleged conspiracy to dump waste oil from five of its cruise ships and for allegedly making false statements about its practices to the Coast Guard.

"The company has used the more than two years since the government initiated its investigation to good purpose: It has upgraded pollution control equipment, installed new computer monitoring equipment, created a new position of environmental enforcement officer onboard its ships and checked, re-checked and improved every element of its environmental program," the company statement said.
